turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Thanks for joining the vendor review.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: I have the contract summary and the staffing forecast.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: I have the latest vendor email open.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: We need to distinguish confirmed facts from items still pending.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: I'll note which questions have a direct answer.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: Let's keep the forecast unchanged until the facts are confirmed.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Before we renew the vendor agreement, I need two details.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: What's the confirmed support capacity for June?

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: The vendor's current sheet only shows May numbers.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: We don't have the June figure in this meeting.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: Can we ask them to confirm the June support capacity?

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: Yes, I'll request the June capacity figure after this call.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Thanks. I'll wait for the written number before changing the forecast.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: I can answer the June capacity question now: the vendor confirmed twelve support agents for June.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: I don't know that from the current contract summary.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Has legal confirmed the weekend coverage clause?

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The legal review is still pending.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: The vendor email lists the twelve-agent capacity in its June table.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: That answers the capacity question; thank you.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The weekend clause is still not confirmed.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: We should not assume weekend coverage from the weekday schedule.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Please keep that question open until legal gives us the clause.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The capacity figure should be reflected in the staffing forecast.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: I haven't updated the forecast yet.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Let's review the vendor response in the next operations meeting.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The June figure is twelve agents, as confirmed.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: And the weekend coverage question remains unanswered.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: Good, record those separately.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The forecast currently assumes ten agents.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: We should not revise it until the vendor's June figure is documented.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: The contract summary does not contain weekend coverage.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: That absence is why legal needs to confirm the clause.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: The next operations review can revisit the open point.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: The capacity answer and coverage question remain separate.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: The June capacity question is answered.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The weekend coverage question remains open.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: I'll send the vendor request follow-up.

turns.speaker: Asha
turns.text: We'll revisit the clause when legal responds.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: The forecast stays unchanged for now.

turns.speaker: Chris
turns.text: Thanks, that's the review.
